title: What we build, in practice.
intro: Six concept projects showing how we approach different kinds of businesses. The brands are fictional; real case studies will replace them as projects launch.
mockupLabel: Illustrative homepage design for {{name}}, a concept {{category}} project

slow-hours.headline: Coffee, on your schedule.
slow-hours.summary: A subscription-first storefront for a small-batch roaster, built around a three-tap reorder flow.

harlow-reed.headline: Counsel that reads the fine print.
harlow-reed.summary: A credibility-led site for a boutique law firm, with practice-area pages written for the client’s search intent.

atlas-freight.headline: Freight that arrives as promised.
atlas-freight.summary: A redesign of a dated B2B site into a quote-request funnel, migrated with a full redirect map.

linden-dental.headline: Dentistry without the dread.
linden-dental.summary: A calm, accessible clinic site where booking an appointment is always one click away.

tallyo.headline: Close the books in a day.
tallyo.summary: A marketing site and product tour for a B2B finance app, with a pricing page designed to qualify leads.

fieldhouse.headline: Gear for the long way round.
fieldhouse.summary: A catalog of 1,200 products reorganized around how customers shop, with filters that actually narrow things down.
